name: Clutter
overview: Scripture encourages believers to maintain order and sanctity in their lives, as seen in God's command to Moses to have the people sanctify themselves and prepare properly (Exodus 19:10). The orderly movement of the camp around the tabernacle reflects the importance of structure and purpose (Numbers 2:17). Wisdom literature highlights the value of simplicity and quietness over a chaotic abundance (Proverbs 17:1), while acknowledging there is a proper time to keep or discard possessions (Ecclesiastes 3:6). Neglect and idleness lead to decay and disorder (Ecclesiastes 10:18), and believers are warned against accumulating earthly treasures that are vulnerable to corruption and loss (Matthew 6:19). Together, these verses teach the importance of spiritual and physical orderliness, intentional stewardship, and prioritizing eternal values over cluttered earthly gain.
